content.short: Pendle is a foundational yield-trading protocol that allows users to tokenize and trade future DeFi asset yields.
content.description: Pendle is a leading decentralized finance protocol that enables the tokenization and trading of future yields, providing participants control over their digital asset returns. The protocol splits yield-bearing tokens into two components: Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT). This model allows users to lock in a guaranteed fixed yield by holding PT or speculate on yield fluctuations by trading YT within a specialized AMM. Operating across major networks like Ethereum and Arbitrum, Pendle is a cornerstone of the yield tokenization sector, fostering a professional landscape.
content.meta: Pendle provides decentralized yield tokenization and trading strategies. Discover Pendle and other DeFi Dapps on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
